verses.text: My son, do not forget my law, and let your heart keep my commandments.

segments.text: My son, do not forget my law, and let your heart keep my commandments.

verses.text: For length of days and years of life and peace they will add to you.

verses.text: And do not let loving devotion and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.text: And you will find favor and good understanding in the eyes of God and man.

verses.text: Put your trust unto YHWH with all your heart, and lean not unto your own understanding.

verses.text: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make straight your paths.

verses.text: Do not be wise in your own eyes, fear YHWH and turn away from evil.

verses.text: Healing it will be to your navel, and refreshment to your bones.

verses.text: For YHWH is at your flank, and He will guard your foot from capture.

verses.text: Do not withhold good from its owners, with it being in the power of your hand to act.
